249 The research variously suggests:
• Rape myths may be deployed at trial.
• Where a juror believes in rape myths, this is more likely to lead to a not guilty verdict than
other factors, such as personal characteristics of age, gender, education or parental
status.

taken place over a year prior to the incident being recorded (these figures exclude Devon and Cornwall Police).
